newsitem.title: USA: Just Like Home amends merger agreement.
newsitem.headline: Just Like Home amends merger agreement.

text.p: Just Like Home Inc said Wednesday it amended its merger agreement with Community Assisted Living Centers Inc, of Nokomis, Fla.
It said that under the amendment, the parites have until April 4 to close the merger. Community also has until April 4 to conplete its due diligence review of Just Like Home, it said.
Richard Conard, chairman and chief executive officer of Just Like Home, said the April 4 deadline was needed because certain due diligence activities have to be completed by that date.
Just Like Home, which manages and develops residential-style assisted living communities, announced the merger agreement in February.
Under the agreement, Just Like Home will acquire all of the assets and operations of Community, whose shareholders it will pay with Just Like Home common stock.
Community currently oeprates a 68-unit assisted living facility in Bradenton and has five other facilities in early stages of development.
